data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 was GBP 590.161m and closing gross claims outstanding at 31 December 2018 was GBP 337.016m, reflecting a large overall run-off during the year. The syndicate completed an external reinsurance to close of 2015 and prior years in 2017 which contributed to prior-years releases; in 2018 reserves were established for significant 2018 natural catastrophe events (Hurricanes Florence and Michael and Californian wildfires) which drove current year adverse claims. Per the claims development table (gross), prior-year development (for underwriting years <=2016) is effectively flat.

data.data_quality_notes: The report does not present an explicit single-line gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure. The claims development triangle (gross) was used to compute prior-year development for underwriting years <=2016, which produced a net zero movement (hence direction 'flat'). Overall gross claims outstanding fell materially from GBP 590.161k to GBP 337.016k during the year (a gross release of GBP 253.145m) driven by large reductions in specific classes (notably Third-party liability) and movements in reinsurance acceptances; these large movements are visible in the balance sheet and class tables but the report does not present a single labelled gross PYD line. Some named event amounts are reported in USD in the narrative ($100.8m gross / $27.4m net) and were not converted. 'Credit and suretyship' was mapped to 'Professional Lines' for LOB movement mapping (approximate).
